messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: ALERT 2472003333 - sharp increase in 95th/99th latency for hosted inference in eu-west-1. Error rate is stable but queued requests in economy tier are spiking. Affected route: /v1/generate (model: rw-13b).

Maya (oncall): seeing large tail, users report slow responses. Paging SRE. Tagging Sam and Leo.

Maya (oncall): summary from dashboard: avg latency 320ms -> 1.8s 95p; token throughput steady. economy acceptance rate dropped to 12%.

Sam (sre): on it. first pass: looks like smart-routing is favoring economy lane in eu-west due to cheap nodes coming back online simultaneously and causing KV-cache churn.

Leo (infra): pulling routing logs now. small snippet: `routes->eu-west: economy 64% -> premium 12%` then sudden oscillation. attaching short grep:```json
{"ts":2472003320, "route":"eu-west","tier":"economy","lat_ms":1790}
{"ts":2472003324, "route":"eu-west","tier":"economy","lat_ms":1942}```

Sam (sre): mitigation plan proposal: 1) temporary hard cap on economy concurrent inflight in eu-west, 2) increase premium weight for eu-west, 3) route a fraction to us-west as regional overflow. low-risk and reversible.

Ellie (product): we should notify CS for customers on dedicated/private if their pinned region moves. Also prepare text for status page.

Maya (oncall): execute 1) and 2) now. Sam, Leo -- coordinate commands. I will watch alerts and notify PD.

Leo (infra): applying policy change - reducing economy_inflight_limit to 400 for eu-west:```yaml
policy: smart-routing
region: eu-west-1
action: set
param: economy_inflight_limit
value: 400
reason: emergency tail-latency mitigation
rollout: immediate
```

Leo (infra): command run: `redwoodctl policies apply --file /tmp/eu-economy-cap.yml --env prod`

IncidentBot: Policy change queued. 2APIs -> config service acknowledged.

Sam (sre): bumping premium weight to 1.4x in eu-west temporarily:```json
{"route":"eu-west-1","adjust":{"premium_weight":1.4}}```

Sam (sre): also enabling regional overflow to us-west: `redwoodctl route adjust --from eu-west-1 --to us-west-2 --pct 10`

Maya (oncall): setting quota shield for economy for now: `quota:update region=eu-west tier=economy rate=70r/s`

PagerDuty: Maya acknowledged; escalation to oncall secondary scheduled if latency > 2s for 3m.

Ellie (product): drafting status: "We are mitigating elevated response times in EU region. Some non-critical low-tier requests may experience temporary throttling while we stabilize routing." will share once SRE confirms.

Sam (sre): immediate telemetry post-change: 95p down to ~680ms within 90s. economy throughput halved, premium spiky but stable. KV cache miss rate reduced by ~30%.

Maya (oncall): Good. Keep overflow at 10% for 30m, then reassess. Sam/Leo, keep me posted every 5m. If 95p > 1s after 15m we escalate to P1 runbook.

Leo (infra): adding a short-term exclusion for economy lane for models with long seq (rw-13b) to avoid cache thrash:```yaml
- matcher: model: rw-13b
  region: eu-west-1
  action: set_tier_preference
  preference: premium
```

Sam (sre): note: customers using dedicated pools unaffected. We should call out impacted customers: auto-scaling PLG apps w/ default tier economy and some EU small SaaS.

Maya (oncall): notified CS to prepare outbound for top 10 affected accounts. Ellie will coordinate messaging.

Ellie (product): CS ack. Draft ready, include mitigation steps and ETA: initial improvements observed, monitoring for 30m then gradual rollback.

Sam (sre): rollback plan: revert economy_inflight_limit and premium weight to baseline once 95p < 450ms for 10m and KV miss < baseline+5%. Commands ready: `redwoodctl policies rollback --id eu-economy-cap` and `redwoodctl route adjust --from eu-west-1 --to us-west-2 --pct 0`.

Maya (oncall): handing over to Sam for steady-state watch. I'm going to bed in 30m, PagerDuty will escalate per policy. Sam, if anything spikes, wake me.

Sam (sre): will own watch. updating thread with minute-by-minute metrics. current: 95p=610ms, 99p=1.05s, economy_accept=20%.

IncidentBot: Note: auto-runbook reminder scheduled in 10m.

Leo (infra): adding a short-lived metric alert to catch reversion: `alert if eu-west 95p > 1s for 3m -> page oncall`

Maya (oncall): thanks team. good coordination. post-incident, we should review smart-routing weighting logic and consider smoothing factor to prevent synchronized lane reentry.

Ellie (product): agreed — schedule retro and include playbook updates for "economy lane spike".

Sam (sre): threading next steps: collect routing logs, KV cache traces, and customer request IDs for CS. will attach artifacts here.

Maya (oncall): last note before handoff: severity P2 (customer-facing latency, degraded, partial mitigation in place). escalate to P1 if customer-reported errors appear or >10% of requests > 2s.

Sam (sre): acknowledged. standing by.

(End of thread)
